logo.description: Cottonworld header wordmark. The current public asset was identified by Firecrawl branding extraction with 0.95 selection confidence.

business_description: Cottonworld is an Indian natural-clothing brand founded in 1987. It sells clothing for men and women in cotton, linen, bamboo and other natural-fabric ranges. The current site frames the offer around simplicity, everyday comfort, long wear, Indian climate and natural materials. Cottonworld sells through its Shopify storefront and physical stores in India.
business_model: B2C omnichannel apparel retail: direct e-commerce on Shopify plus physical stores in India. The primary online transaction is a product purchase through add-to-cart and checkout.

brand_colors.source: Firecrawl branding extraction from the live homepage, 2026-07-27

brand_aesthetic: Warm, natural and lifestyle-led. The live design uses olive green, white, rounded controls, Nunito typography, large editorial photography and occasion-led merchandising. It presents timeless daily wear rather than rapid trend turnover.

brand_voice.description: Warm, plain and reassuring. Cottonworld leads with comfort, natural fabric, usefulness and longevity. Strong source-backed lines are short and declarative: 'Made for everyday life', 'Rooted in simplicity', 'Natural fabrics', 'Everyday comfort', and 'Made to be lived in'.
voice_patterns: Short declarative lines, often two to six words
Comfort and natural fabric before trend language
Simple, human contrasts such as worn once versus worn often
Occasion-led language: work, brunch, summer and travel

brand_values: Natural fabrics at the heart of the range
Comfort and breathability for everyday wear

primary: Indian men and women seeking comfortable natural-fabric daily clothing
Shoppers looking for cotton, linen or bamboo clothing suited to India's climate
Quality-oriented buyers who value repeat wear over fast-fashion novelty
roles: Returning customers of an established Indian apparel brand
